data.body: Implemented skills/skill.schema.json, contract documentation, a file-backed code-change-verification example with reusable report template, and tests that reject persona-only records. Dependency-free JSON/schema invariant, asset-resolution, persona-rejection, and git diff checks pass. Full npm tests/typecheck/format could not run because dependencies are absent and registry access fails with ENOTFOUND; committing is also blocked because the worktree Git metadata is read-only.
